introSteps.title: Repair & Reset
introSteps.subtitle: Fixes for the most common Mac problems. Save your work first: some fixes quit apps, and a few remove local data.

stats.label: Take out what is in the way

introSteps.title: What should we fix?
introSteps.subtitle: Switch on what should run. Fix everything includes the safe resets; red sections remove something for good.

optionCards.label: Fix everything
optionCards.subtitle: Runs every reset below that loses nothing

optionCards.label: Clear app caches
optionCards.subtitle: Caches rebuild themselves on next launch

optionCards.label: Reset printing
optionCards.subtitle: Removes printers and stuck jobs; re-add printers after

optionCards.label: Renew network
optionCards.subtitle: Flushes DNS and renews the DHCP lease

optionCards.label: Reset Bluetooth
optionCards.subtitle: Forgets the module state; devices reconnect

optionCards.label: Rebuild Spotlight
optionCards.subtitle: Search is slow for an hour while it re-indexes

optionCards.label: Forget saved app passwords
optionCards.subtitle: Apps ask you to sign in again

optionCards.label: Sign out of company apps
optionCards.subtitle: Every company app signs out; includes saved passwords

optionCards.label: Erase offline files
optionCards.subtitle: Cached copies of synced folders
optionCards.exposure: Permanently deletes files not yet synced

optionCards.label: Reinstall company apps
optionCards.subtitle: Removes and reinstalls every company app
optionCards.exposure: Deletes local app data; documents in your folders are kept

optionCards.label: Remove the management agent
optionCards.subtitle: Security and update checks stop
optionCards.exposure: Stops security checks on this Mac until IT reinstalls it

introSteps.title: Ready to run
introSteps.subtitle: This is everything that will run, and anything you picked that won't — and why.

reviewAcknowledge.label: I understand these fixes remove data for good
reviewAcknowledge.subtitle: There is no undo

introSteps.title: Repairing this Mac
introSteps.subtitle: Keep this window open. Apps may quit while a fix runs.
introSteps.completedMessage: Every fix you picked has run.

introSteps.title: Restart recommended
introSteps.subtitle: A restart finishes most resets. Save your work in other apps first.

optionCards.label: Restart now
optionCards.subtitle: Your Mac restarts when you continue

optionCards.label: Later
optionCards.subtitle: Restart before you report the problem again

introSteps.title: Repair finished
introSteps.subtitle: If the problem comes back, contact IT and mention which fixes you ran.
